death.attack.veneficus.killing_curse: %1$s died in a flash of green light
death.attack.veneficus.killing_curse.ite: %1$s was killed by %2$s with the Killing Curse, using %3$s
death.attack.veneficus.killing_curse.pla: %1$s was killed by %2$s with the Killing Curse
death.attack.veneficus.spell: %1$s was struck down by a spell
origin.veneficus.wizard.description: Casts spells with a wand: charms, Transfiguration and, for those who dare, the Dark Arts. Learn up to eight spells at a time in the Spellbook skill tree and cast them with patterns of left and right clicks.
origin.veneficus.wizard.name: Wizard
power.veneficus.wizard/accio.description: Summons the creature or items you aim at to your side.
power.veneficus.wizard/accio.name: Accio
power.veneficus.wizard/accio/info.descri: Pulls the creature, player or loose items you aim at toward you, up to 26 blocks away. Anything more than 12 blocks away is brought to you first, then pulled the rest of the way.
power.veneficus.wizard/accio/info.name: Accio
power.veneficus.wizard/alohomora.descrip: Opens or closes doors, trapdoors and gates from afar, iron ones too.
power.veneficus.wizard/alohomora.name: Alohomora
power.veneficus.wizard/alohomora/info.de: Opens or closes the door, trapdoor or fence gate you aim at, up to 16 blocks away. Iron doors and iron trapdoors open without redstone.
power.veneficus.wizard/altering_spell.de: Changes the look of a block or a creature.
power.veneficus.wizard/altering_spell/in: Changes what you aim at, up to 12 blocks away. Wool, carpet, concrete, terracotta and stained glass change colour. Crops and saplings grow. Blocks that face a direction turn. Sheep, horses, cats, foxes, parrots, axolotls, rabbits, llamas, mooshrooms, frogs, wolves and villagers change their colour or variety.
Slows everything in front of you to a crawl, arrows included.
power.veneficus.wizard/arresto_momentum/: Slows every creature, player, arrow and item in a cone in front of you, up to 16 blocks away. Creatures stay slowed for five seconds and drift down gently. Cast it while falling, or while looking straight down, to break your own fall.
power.veneficus.wizard/avada_kedavra.des: The Killing Curse. A flash of green light, and death.
power.veneficus.wizard/avada_kedavra/inf: An Unforgivable Curse. A jet of green light that kills whatever it hits, up to 32 blocks away. Armor and Protego don't stop it, though a totem of undying still can, and it deals at most 50 hearts to a boss. Casting it leaves you weakened for eight seconds. Ready again after a minute.
power.veneficus.wizard/basic_cast.descri: A burst of red sparks. Free to learn.
power.veneficus.wizard/basic_cast.name: Basic Cast
power.veneficus.wizard/basic_cast/info.d: Shoots a burst of red sparks at whatever you aim at, up to 24 blocks away. It deals one and a half hearts and nudges the target back. Ready again after half a second.
power.veneficus.wizard/bombarda.descript: A small explosion where the spell lands. Loud and bright.
power.veneficus.wizard/bombarda.name: Bombarda
power.veneficus.wizard/bombarda/info.des: Detonates a small explosion where the spell lands, up to 32 blocks away, strong enough to blow open doors and break walls. The flash dazzles anyone close to the blast, you included. Ready again after eight seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/confringo.descrip: A blasting curse that explodes where it lands.
power.veneficus.wizard/confringo.name: Confringo
power.veneficus.wizard/confringo/info.de: A fiery bolt that explodes where it lands, up to 32 blocks away, without breaking blocks. A creature it hits directly also catches fire for four seconds. Ready again after seven seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/crucio.descriptio: The Cruciatus Curse. Five seconds of torment that clouds the mind.
power.veneficus.wizard/crucio.name: Crucio
power.veneficus.wizard/crucio/info.descr: An Unforgivable Curse. The target writhes in agony for five seconds, losing half a heart every half second whatever their armor. As the curse goes on their sight swims and splits. Protego can't stop it. Ready again after thirty seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/crucio/info.name: Crucio
power.veneficus.wizard/depulso.descripti: Blasts the target far away from you.
power.veneficus.wizard/depulso.name: Depulso
power.veneficus.wizard/depulso/info.desc: Hurls the creature, player or loose items you aim at away from you, up to 24 blocks away. Ready again after three seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/depulso/info.name: Depulso
power.veneficus.wizard/expelliarmus.desc: Knocks the item out of the target's hand and sends it flying to you.
power.veneficus.wizard/expelliarmus.name: Expelliarmus
power.veneficus.wizard/expelliarmus/info: Knocks whatever the target holds out of their hand and sends it flying toward you, up to 24 blocks away. It works on mobs too, so a disarmed skeleton can't shoot. Ready again after six seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/finite_incantatem: Ends the spells and curses on the target. Look down to free yourself.

Ends the spells, jinxes and curses on whoever you aim at: body binds, stuns, levitation, the Cruciatus Curse, slowness, blindness, nausea, weakness, darkness and glowing. It also puts out fire, ends their Lumos and breaks their Protego. Look straight down when you cast it to free yourself.
power.veneficus.wizard/flipendo.descript: A jinx that knocks the target backwards, head over heels.
power.veneficus.wizard/flipendo.name: Flipendo
power.veneficus.wizard/flipendo/info.des: Knocks the target back and flips it head over heels, up to 24 blocks away, for one heart of damage. It also shoves carts, boats and loose items. Ready again after four seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/incantations.desc: With the Birdsong mod installed, you can also cast a spell you know by saying its incantation while you hold your wand, such as Stupefy or Wingardium Leviosa. Say Nox to put out Lumos. A spoken spell recharges the same way as a clicked one.
power.veneficus.wizard/incantations.name: Incantations
power.veneficus.wizard/incendio.descript: A jet of flame that sets things alight.
power.veneficus.wizard/incendio.name: Incendio
power.veneficus.wizard/incendio/info.des: Shoots a jet of flame eight blocks ahead. Creatures in it take a heart of damage and burn for five seconds. Where it hits the ground it starts a fire, and it lights campfires and candles. Ready again after four seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/lumos.description: Lights the tip of your wand. Cast it again, or say Nox, to put it out. Free to learn.
power.veneficus.wizard/lumos.name: Lumos
power.veneficus.wizard/lumos/info.descri: Lights the tip of your wand while you hold it, so you and everyone near you can see in the dark. You also see a little better in dim places. Cast it again to put the light out, or say Nox.
power.veneficus.wizard/lumos/info.name: Lumos
power.veneficus.wizard/petrificus_totalu: Binds the target stiff as a board, and it topples over.

Binds the target's body stiff, up to 24 blocks away, and it topples over. A player stays bound for three seconds and can't move or look around. A mob stays bound for five. Ready again after seven seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/protego.descripti: A shield that reflects spells and turns aside arrows and blows.
power.veneficus.wizard/protego.name: Protego
power.veneficus.wizard/protego/info.desc: Raises a shield around you for three seconds. Spells that hit it are reflected back at the caster, arrows and other projectiles bounce off, attacks deal no damage and the attacker is pushed back. Unforgivable Curses go straight through, and Finite Incantatem breaks it. Ready again after ten seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/protego/info.name: Protego
power.veneficus.wizard/revelio.descripti: Reveals creatures, players and ores around you for ten seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/revelio.name: Revelio
power.veneficus.wizard/revelio/info.desc: Sends out a wave that reveals every creature and player within 16 blocks, outlined through walls, and the ores around you, for ten seconds. Disguised creatures near you lose their disguise. Ready again after fifteen seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/revelio/info.name: Revelio
power.veneficus.wizard/spell_studies.des: Learn spells in the Spellbook skill tree. Your wand holds eight spells at a time, and a new spell takes the first free pattern. Shift-click a spell in the tree to forget it and get its points back. Basic Cast and Lumos are free. Every 25 spells you land on creatures earn a spell point, at most one every second and a half.
power.veneficus.wizard/spellcasting.desc: Hold your wand and click three times to cast a spell: left or right, in any order, such as left, right, left. Each of the eight patterns casts one of your spells. While you hold the wand, a panel at the side of your screen shows which spell each pattern casts, dims the ones your clicks rule out and shades the ones that are still recharging. Middle-click to open your spellbook and move a spell to another pattern.
power.veneficus.wizard/spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
power.veneficus.wizard/stupefy.descripti: Stuns the target and knocks it off its feet.
power.veneficus.wizard/stupefy.name: Stupefy
power.veneficus.wizard/stupefy/info.desc: Knocks the target back and stuns it, up to 28 blocks away. A stunned player blacks out for two and a half seconds and can't move. A stunned mob lies still for four. Ready again after five seconds.
power.veneficus.wizard/stupefy/info.name: Stupefy
power.veneficus.wizard/wandlore.descript: You start with an elder wand. To make another, use an amethyst shard, a feather or a phantom membrane on a stick in your inventory, the way you would fill a bundle. Only a wizard can cast with a wand.
power.veneficus.wizard/wandlore.name: Wandlore
power.veneficus.wizard/wingardium_levios: Makes the target float in the air for four seconds.
Lifts the creature, player or loose items you aim at about two blocks into the air and holds them there for four seconds. Look straight down when you cast it to lift yourself.
skill.veneficus.spellbook/charms.descrip: Spells that add a property to something or someone.
skill.veneficus.spellbook/charms.name: Charms
skill.veneficus.spellbook/curses.descrip: Dark charms that bind and blast.
skill.veneficus.spellbook/curses.name: Curses
skill.veneficus.spellbook/dark_arts.desc: Dark charms: jinxes, hexes and curses.
skill.veneficus.spellbook/dark_arts.name: Dark Arts
skill.veneficus.spellbook/defensive.name: Defensive Charms
skill.veneficus.spellbook/jinxes.name: Jinxes
skill.veneficus.spellbook/offensive.name: Offensive Charms
skill.veneficus.spellbook/transfiguratio: Changing the form and colour of things.
skill.veneficus.spellbook/unforgivable.d: The worst of the Dark Arts.
skill.veneficus.spellbook/utility.name: Everyday Charms
skill_tree.veneficus.spellbook.descripti: Your wand holds eight spells. Shift-click a spell to forget it.
skill_tree.veneficus.spellbook.name: Spellbook
veneficus.badge.casting: Click %s and %s in patterns of three while holding your wand. %s opens your spellbook.
veneficus.badge.incantations: Needs the Birdsong mod on the server and on your game.
veneficus.badge.spell: %s. Say "%s" while holding your wand to cast it out loud (needs Birdsong).
veneficus.badge.spell_silent: %s. It has no incantation, so it can only be cast with a pattern.
veneficus.badge.studies: Open the Spellbook skill tree with %s.
veneficus.badge.wandlore: Use an amethyst shard, a feather or a phantom membrane on a stick in your inventory.
veneficus.hud.empty: Nothing is bound to that pattern
